course_access_routing_plan.user_confirmed_terminology: Users may say launch when they mean opening Moodle course material or activities. The word launch alone does not establish the content platform.
course_access_routing_plan.user_confirmed_moodle_navigation: Moodle course tiles can be opened from Dashboard or My Courses under Instructor-Led Courses. There is no classic course-start Launch button within Moodle.
course_access_routing_plan.user_confirmed_mcele_entry: Moodle courses may also be listed in MCeLE My Courses. Launch can redirect to Moodle, but this handoff sometimes fails.
course_access_routing_plan.user_confirmed_handoff_alternative: For a confirmed Moodle course whose MCeLE handoff fails, access Instructor-Led Courses from the left navigation menu.
course_access_routing_plan.estimate_use: Approximate user estimate for test coverage; never use it to determine a particular user's platform or permissions.
course_access_routing_plan.unsupported_detail_behavior: For a missing Moodle course tile or a material/activity that will not open, use the user-approved Student Support Help Desk escalation, option 3 for Moodle support. Keep MCeLE self-paced launch troubleshooting scoped to the appropriate content platform and enrolled-course task.
course_access_routing_plan.role_task_rule: Identify the current task. An Instructor or AO accessing an enrolled course receives the same applicable learner guidance as everyone else; course creation or management does not follow from the role alone.
course_access_routing_plan.implemented_resolution: Use a confirmed course/task mapping when available. Otherwise clarify the course or destination one useful question at a time. Keep the MCeLE entry point separate from the Moodle content destination.
implemented_paths: MCeLE self-paced course launch failure: reviewed Launch Course guidance when access and symptom match.
MCeLE-to-Moodle handoff failure: reviewed Accessing Moodle guidance with Instructor-Led Courses left-navigation wording.

Already inside Moodle: distinguish a missing course tile from a material/activity that will not open, then use the approved Student Support Help Desk escalation, option 3 for Moodle support, when there is no matching supported procedure.
Moodle app issue: keep the app-specific guidance and method for follow-ups.
